_comment: 🧪️ The presentation product's contribution to the repository test platform. Every entry is a test-only reference implementation for one part of the slide authoring pipeline; the subject is the product's own compiler under 📦️packages/🟦️typescript. Every package listed here is a devDependency of the declared hostPath and is imported only from 🧪️tests/**.

packages.role: CommonMark parser — markdown text to an mdast syntax tree.
GitHub Flavoured Markdown extension — the table syntax the slide compiler claims.
mdast to hast — the markdown tree read as an HTML tree.
hast to an HTML fragment, including the character references the fragment escapes with.

oracles.rationale: The reading of CommonMark and GFM the JavaScript ecosystem is measured against. The presentation product owns its slide markdown compiler — a deck must not ship a markdown runtime, and the fragment it emits is a safety boundary — so without an external reference that compiler would only ever agree with itself. The stack is composed rather than singular because the contract spans four stages: parse (remark-parse), the GFM table extension (remark-gfm), the markdown-to-HTML tree mapping (remark-rehype) and the fragment serialisation with its character references (rehype-stringify). unified is the pipeline that binds them and is the primary package the entry is pinned on.
